Original Effective Date:

Review Date:
3/16/2026
Policy type:
Medical Necessity
Line of Business:
All G.E.H.A Medical Plans
Authorizations are issued for 6 (six) months, unless the ordering physician requests a different timespan or the patients' unique circumstance or condition supports the medical necessity for a different authorization timeframe. Reauthorization requests are reviewed for efficacy, safety and tolerability. For patients who achieve a complete response (CR), no further treatment beyond 8 cycles is recommended. For patients who achieve a partial response (PR) or have stable disease (SD), a total of 17 cycles are recommended, unless the patient experiences disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

section: Follicular Lymphoma - Relapsed or Refractory (Grade 1, 2 or 3A)
text:
Follicular Lymphoma - Relapsed or Refractory (Grade 1, 2 or 3A)
- Lunsumio will be used as monotherapy; AND
- The member is 18 years of age or older; AND
- The member has not had prior treatment with chimeric antigen receptor T-cell (CART-T) therapy within 30 days before administration; AND
- The member has not had an allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant; AND
- The member has not had an autologous stem cel transplant within the past 100 days; AND
- The member's Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) score of 0 or 2; AND
- The member has no history of CNS lymphoma or CNS disorders; AND
- The member has no active infection (e.g. viral, bacterial, fungal) such as HIV, active hepatitis B or active hepatitis C; AND
- The member has received 2 or more prior lines of therapy that includes anti-CD20 therapy (e.g., rituximab) and an alkylating agent (e.g., cyclophosphamide); AND
- Prescribed by, or in consultation with, an oncologist
